scope: Released-SDK baseline for the WW27 top/bottom performers case.
supported: add_calculated_field(..., table_calc='Columns') for the WINDOW_PERCENTILE addressing
configure_layered_chart(axis_shelf='columns', fold_axes=True, synchronized=True) for the overlaid Bar + GanttBar panes
sort_mode='computed' with sort_field and sort_descending for the profit/sales-descending order
configure_chart for the Month Selector square sheet

findings.summary: Addressing WINDOW_PERCENTILE by Rows or by a single dimension makes it compute per-cell, so every row's percentile equals its own value and the whole table classifies as 'Top'.
findings.workaround: Address the percentile and Colour fields by Columns (table_calc='Columns'), which spans the whole table.
